svg.title: Southern East Madagascar Current: two reported dimensions
svg.desc: About 650 kilometres is a contextual southward branch extent. About 120 kilometres is a near-surface width from sections T5 to T8 in April 2001. Separate scales and supports. Reported extent rank12; local survey width not ranked. No current footprint, annual range or uncertainty interval.

g.text: Reported extent ranked · local survey width recorded
